# The CITATION IS NOT TYPED HERE. pipeline/build_symptom_map.py renders the
# manual phrasing and page from golden/symptoms/ for each target id, the same
# way eval/citations.py renders a citation from a fact_id. A citation nobody
# types is a citation nobody can get wrong, and an id that does not exist fails
# the build rather than shipping as a plausible-looking entry.
# Vocabulary is taken from the manual's own titles -- boom, arm, bucket, swing,
# travel, track, attachment, fan, coolant, exhaust -- combined with the Roman
# Urdu a technician actually types. No symptom is invented here: every target
# is an id that exists in golden/symptoms/.
